target_execution_preparation.remaining: Admitted for nine histories, eleven old terminals, and post-global-seal five-role audit.

frozen.source_models: Original family assets for frontend and nine controls; six sealed permuted assets only for the two added role backends.
frozen.initial_policies: Unchanged source-only design80; same physical initial10 across streams, with independent stream observations shared across its nine histories.
frozen.shared_neighbors: Each stream independently applies the unchanged shared64 generator to its own STOP engine; physically shared across arms within that stream. No bank or raw observation is copied from the other stream.
frozen.frontend: Unchanged original frontend and shared-neighbor supplement; adaptive proposals continue to learn from each arm own new history.
frozen.terminal: Unchanged old/default same_policy_distinct_challenger only; original shortlist and objective guard, safety80/128/128, comparison8 per policy, total cap352.

randomness.optimizer_seed: Same geometry_task_seed as config.seed in both streams; observation and verification seeds do not replace the optimizer seed.
randomness.observation_stream: SeedSequence([observation_seed, evaluation_index, SIMULATION_STREAM_TAG]); indices0..9 initialization and10..12 adaptive queries.
randomness.verification_stream: Use registered independent verification_seed with unchanged slot/replication/safety/objective stream namespaces.
randomness.pairing: Within each task/replicate all arms use matching observation and verification namespaces. Same evaluation index can query different policies; shared random numbers do not make responses identical.
randomness.limitation: New observations can change adaptive pools, trajectories and RNG consumption. Fixed optimizer seed does not freeze every per-policy TS innovation.
randomness.reuse: Never reuse old observations or certificates across the new streams. Only exactly matching new-stream physical observations may be shared with explicit accounting.
randomness.cross_stream: Independent registered observation and verification namespaces. Same source-only initial physical design and geometry; each stream generates its own shared64 from its own STOP state, so realized banks and adaptive pools may differ.
randomness.planning_scope: Historical Stage76 streams reused a previously frozen shared64 bank. Their two-stream variance is a planning scenario, not a guarantee for fresh geometries whose banks follow their own STOP observations; the separate new-geometry single-stream planning batch is not divided by two.

geometry_description: Generator(PCG64(2026200000)); for each geometry in family order draw shift uniform(-0.035,0.035,size=3), then radius uniform(0.95,1.05).
objective: Correct source policy-response association improves frozen AFTER deployment and strengthens initialization-propagation value, conditional on the original source-trained frontend.
statistical_unit: 144 geometries, two paired observation streams within each geometry.

barriers.before_sampling: Explicit target admission after substitute checks and one-time metadata registration.
barriers.before_online: All 288 stream-specific initializations and banks complete or retained failures.
barriers.before_verification: All 2592 histories and all 3168 terminal inputs frozen or explicit missing/failed.
barriers.before_scoring: All 3168 old-terminal cells complete or failed/missing and globally sealed before complete-pool truth access.
barriers.failure: Preserve paid prefixes and fees. No automatic retry, replacement geometry, refit or redraw.

analysis.C: Original certified-and-truly-feasible indicator; false certification reported separately.
analysis.G: Original signed certified quality above best truly feasible initial10; G=P-L. No certificate gives G=0 only if baseline is defined; actual deployment quality remains unknown.
analysis.pairing: Compute per-stream contrasts then average both streams within geometry before original 95% geometry t intervals; report each stream and family separately.
analysis.missing: Missing baseline or failed execution remains null. If either required stream/cell is absent, the two-stream geometry effect is null. Keep full denominator and separately report defined subsets. Interaction requires a common four-arm subset.
retain: new positive quality versus avoided loss
largest positive contribution and descriptive leave-largest-out sensitivity
analysis.secondary_inference: Individual intervals are not a multiplicity-adjusted set of claims. A positive interaction alone does not establish real AFTER deployment superiority.
analysis.mechanisms: Reuse frozen multi-safe/single-safe/minimum-violation/requery/list/safety/objective-comparison categories; do not present descriptive decomposition as identified mediation.
analysis.historical_batches: Keep 7001-7024 dual streams, 202611 new24 single stream, Stage85 new144 dual streams and this future cohort separate.
limitations: Conditional on original source-trained frontend and three fixed permutations
Not a source-free calibrated baseline or proof of source necessity
Geometry sample does not replicate source-model randomization
New-interaction precision unknown; no enlargement or threshold/model tuning

saved_score_contract.record: Passively save already-computed query scores, final observed-pool ranks and list construction. No extra online scoring.
saved_score_contract.postseal_union: Saved pools for five role histories, common initial10, all eleven terminal lists/deployments. Missing states remain missing; no restorative scoring.
